t: The Workflow Factory: A Case Study in Emergent Modularity
s: Pipulate evolved from rigid, numbered workflows to a modular 'workflow factory' by decoupling step display from execution logic, enabling easy synthesis of new applications from existing parts through semantic naming and helper tools.
sub: Decoupling display order from execution logic
Workflow factory for synthesizing new applications
Helper tools for workflow manipulation and transplantation
Refactoring to named steps and cache optimization
